title: Floria: Floria Mood Journal
release_notes: New: ultra-fast one‑tap emoji logging; multi‑mood with optional intensity; tags; markdown notes with autosave; trusted streaks with day start and grace window; calendar and history with search; multiple reminders and snooze; concise insights and optional text-only sentiment; encrypted local backups with schedules and version history; CSV/JSON export (free) and Pro PDF reports; PIN/biometric lock; themes and high‑contrast mode; privacy screen and anonymous mode; audit log for backups/restores/purchases.
full_description:
Floria Mood Journal makes floria mood journal logging instant: tap an emoji to save your mood in under a second, add an optional note or tags, and get clear weekly highlights—no account required, works offline.

Why Floria
• Ultra-fast: open → tap → Saved. Undo for 5 seconds. Multiple entries per day.
• Private by default: data stays on your device; PIN/biometric lock included.
• Trustworthy: reliable streaks with fair day-start and grace window.
• Clear insights: weekly averages, top tags, and time-of-day patterns.
• Exports that respect you: CSV/JSON always free and portable.

Core features
• One-tap emoji logging with configurable moods and colors.
• Add up to 3 moods per entry with optional 1–10 intensity.
• Tags for context (e.g., Work, Sleep, Friends) with easy add/edit/delete.
• Quick Note Editor with markdown basics (headings, bold, lists), autosave, and full-screen mode.
• Streaks you can trust: set your day start (0–6 AM) and a late-entry grace period.
• Calendar & History: month view with color intensity; tap any date to view or backfill; search by text, tags, and emoji.
• Multiple reminders: set daily times, days of week, or an hourly range; snooze 15/30/60 minutes.
• Insights & Weekly Summary: week/month/custom ranges, weighted averages, time-of-day heatline, and optional on-demand note sentiment via text-only AI proxy when you ask for it.
• Backups & Restore: create encrypted local backups; schedule automatic backups; keep version history; one-tap restore with a preview and an audit log.
• Export: free CSV/JSON with timestamps, moods, intensity, tags, sentiment, note length, and media references.
• Security Lock: free PIN/biometric lock, auto-lock timer, and a clear privacy screen; anonymous mode to mask previews.
• Themes & Accessibility: system dark mode, high-contrast option, large tap targets, and font scaling.

What’s free
• All core logging: emojis, multi-mood, tags, notes, calendar, and basic insights.
• Multiple reminders and trusted streaks.
• PIN/biometric lock.
• Encrypted local backup and restore.
• CSV/JSON export.
• Small optional banner only in Settings for Free; never interrupts logging.

Go Pro (lifetime or subscription)
• Advanced insights over custom ranges, including deeper breakdowns by tag and time of day.
• Styled PDF/CSV reports with filters and charts.
• Custom themes and app icons.
• Higher media limits per entry and batch export of media references.
• Optional cloud backup/sync with simple email-code login (encrypted in transit and at rest).
• Priority support and early-access toggles.

Privacy and control
• Works fully offline; no account needed to use the app.
• Backups are encrypted with your passphrase; you control your files.
• AI features are optional and only process the text you choose to send.

Designed for quick daily use
• Thumb-friendly, portrait-first UI for short sessions.
• Haptics and subtle animations that never slow you down.
• Weekly highlight notification (optional) to review trends.

Who it’s for
• Anyone wanting a calm, private daily mood journal with emoji simplicity and meaningful insights.
• Great fit if you search for a mood tracker emoji experience that doesn’t get in your way.
• Also helpful for a daily mood journal routine where notes add context over time.

Get started now: open Floria, tap an emoji, and see your first save in seconds. Build a steady streak, learn from clear insights, and keep your data in your hands.
